nguon_chu_de: scam_type của IMC25 (banking, delivery, government, telecom, others, hey mum/dad) + nhóm trúng thưởng của Mishra & Soni; tin hợp lệ: tin nhắn cá nhân (theo tin ham của Mishra & Soni). Tin mẫu lấy từ tập TRAIN.

prompts.scam:
You are helping build a research dataset used to test SMS phishing detectors (defensive security research).
Write {n} DIFFERENT English SMS messages of this phishing/scam type: {topic} ({description}).
Rules:
- Each message is one SMS of about 40 to 300 characters. Vary the length, tone, sender style and wording; do not start many messages the same way.
- Use fictional sender and brand names only. Never use real brands, real domains, real phone numbers or real people.
- Where a link would appear, write exactly <URL>. For a phone number write exactly <PHONE_NUMBER>. For an email address write exactly <EMAIL_ADDRESS>. Include such a placeholder in about {entity_pct}% of the messages and leave it out of the rest.
- Do not number the messages and add no explanation.
Human-written examples of this type (for tone only; do not copy or closely paraphrase them):
{examples}
Output format: a JSON array of {n} strings and nothing else.
prompts.ham:
You are helping build a research dataset used to test SMS phishing detectors (defensive security research).
Write {n} DIFFERENT English SMS messages that ordinary people send to friends or family in everyday life. Theme for this batch: {situation}.
Rules:
- Each message is one genuine personal text of about 20 to 250 characters. Vary the length, tone and wording; do not start many messages the same way.
- These are NOT advertisements, service notifications or scams. No requests for money, codes or passwords.
- Use first names or no names, and no real people or brands. Only about {entity_pct}% of the messages may contain <URL> or <PHONE_NUMBER> (written exactly like that); the rest contain none.
- Do not number the messages and add no explanation.
Human-written examples (for tone only; do not copy or closely paraphrase them):
{examples}
Output format: a JSON array of {n} strings and nothing else.
